# Integration Standards

This directory contains standards related to system integration, data exchange, and inter-system communication patterns.
page_texts.3:
[standards/application/integration/README.md#overview]

## Overview

Integration standards ensure consistent approaches to connecting systems, exchanging data, and maintaining reliable communication across the enterprise architecture.

### [Kafka Management](./kafka-management/)

Standards for managing, monitoring, and operating Kafka-based integration infrastructure.

**Standards**: 5
- **STD-APP-INT-005**: Integration Monitoring
- **STD-APP-INT-006**: Data Flow Visualization
- **STD-APP-INT-007**: Anomaly Detection
- **STD-APP-INT-008**: LSQL Transformations
- **STD-APP-INT-009**: Data Quality Rules

[standards/application/integration/README.md#creating-new-standards]

## Creating New Standards

When creating new integration standards:

1. Review the [Standards Creation Guidelines](../../standards-creation-guidelines.md)
2. Use the standard template from [Work Templates](../../../resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/)
3. Follow the [Quality Checklist](../../standards-quality-checklist.md)
4. Submit for Architecture Review Board approval
